title: Microsoft Purview: retention for Microsoft 365 Copilot memory
summary: The briefing accurately reports the disagreement between the launched roadmap item and Learn's preview guidance, and the corrected retention command is documented. The retention policy UI route is correct but stops at the start of the wizard rather than the retention setting; this is a minor finding.

claims.claim: Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy starts creation of the retention policy.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal > Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies. ... Select New retention policy to start the Create retention policy configuration
claims.fix: Extend controls[0].ui.path and its rendered table path to 'Solutions > Data Lifecycle Management > Policies > Retention policies > New retention policy > Assign admin units > Full directory > Choose the type of retention policy to create > Static > Choose locations to apply the policy > Microsoft Copilot experiences > Decide if you want to retain content, delete it, or both'. This is the documented static-policy route at https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/create-retention-policies.

claims.claim: New-AppRetentionComplianceRule with Name, Policy, RetentionDuration and RetentionComplianceAction creates the retention rule that sets duration and action.
claims.quote:
New-AppRetentionComplianceRule
    [-Name] <String>
    -Policy <PolicyIdParameter>
    ...
    [-RetentionComplianceAction <String>]
    [-RetentionDuration <Unlimited>]

claims.claim: RetentionDuration accepts the hold duration in days.
claims.quote: The RetentionDuration parameter specifies the hold duration for the retention rule. Valid values are: ... An integer: The hold duration in days. ... Unlimited: The content is held indefinitely.

claims.claim: RetentionComplianceAction accepts Keep, Delete or KeepAndDelete.
claims.quote: The RetentionComplianceAction parameter specifies the retention action for the rule. Valid values are: ... Delete ... Keep ... KeepAndDelete

claims.claim: The Policy parameter identifies the app retention compliance policy that contains the rule.
claims.quote: The Policy parameter specifies the app retention compliance policy that contains the app retention compliance policy rule. You can use any value that uniquely identifies the policy. For example: ... Name ... Distinguished name (DN) ... GUID

claims.claim: New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy creates the app retention policy separately.
claims.quote: Use the New-AppRetentionCompliancePolicy to create app retention compliance policies.

claims.claim: After creating a policy, New-AppRetentionComplianceRule creates and assigns its retention rule.
claims.quote: After you create the retention policy, use the New-AppRetentionComplianceRule cmdlet to create a retention rule and assign it the retention policy to it.

claims.claim: Enhanced personalization controls whether Copilot memory can be used.
claims.quote: Enhanced personalization is the control that allows Copilot memory to be used by end-users.

claims.claim: Enhanced personalization is on by default.
claims.quote: By default, Enhanced personalization is turned on.

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization stops Copilot applying saved memories.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Saved memories control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat, but doesn't remove saved memories.

claims.claim: Turning off Enhanced personalization does not remove saved memories.
claims.quote: If the Enhanced personalization control is turned off at the admin-level, or if the Saved memories control is turned off at the end-user level, Copilot is stopped from applying saved memories to the chat, but doesn't remove saved memories.
